KAKAROTMOD-SUPER_SAIYAN_FORM_POWER.title: Super Saiyan
KAKAROTMOD-SUPER_SAIYAN_FORM_POWER.descr: Stages 1 to 3. Gain Strength and Dexterity by stage. At turn start, pay 2/3/4 rage to sustain the form. If you cannot, drop one stage; stage 1 reverts. While transformed, your first Attack each turn grants 1/2/3 rage by stage. Stage 2 gains +1 Energy each turn. Stage 3 adds Ki Leaks, draws 1 extra card, and doubles your first Attack once.
KAKAROTMOD-SUPER_SAIYAN_FORM_POWER.smart: Stage 1: Gain {Strength} Strength and {Dexterity} Dexterity. Pay 2 rage at turn start to sustain it; otherwise revert. Your first Attack each turn grants 1 rage while transformed. S-Cell training cards you play lose 1 less HP (minimum 1 HP lost).

Stage 2: Gain {Strength} Strength and {Dexterity} Dexterity. Pay 3 rage at turn start to sustain it; otherwise drop to stage 1. After Energy resets, +1 Energy. Your first Attack each turn grants 2 rage while transformed. S-Cell training cards you play lose 2 less HP (minimum 1 HP lost).

Stage 3: Gain {Strength} Strength and {Dexterity} Dexterity. Pay 4 rage at turn start to sustain it; otherwise drop to stage 2. Ki Leaks each turn (escalates, max 2), draw +1; first Attack doubles once. Your first Attack each turn grants 3 rage while transformed. S-Cell training cards you play lose 2 less HP (minimum 1 HP lost).
